title: Divine Knowledge and the Ascent from Depths
english: When his providence and creative order are understood as manifesting much propriety, it happens only by command. For such is also the providential [order] to the one capable of saying, 'I understood your works and was astounded' (Ps 70:9a); and it is consistent with the present [context], 'He cast a new song into my mouth, a hymn to our God' (Ps 70:9a). 'Upon you is my hope from my youth' (Ps 70:9a). I beseech [you] in this state to remain until old age, not being rejected from you, [but] one who does all vain things and acts lawlessly being rejected.

And let it be considered also toward thought; since old age is precious not because of long duration, but because of much divine wisdom of the inward man and old age of an unblemished life through supreme virtue; since I am at the peak of progressing, I beseech [you] not to reject [me] but to cooperate by your goodness, so that I may reach the time of unblemished life. For if Christ is the one saying, 'If being an enemy, let them shame me, I have lifted up [my head]' (Ps 70:10-11); for this is also what is said regarding these things about Judas.

Of my shameful enemies who hastened to my ruin (Ps 70:14-16), I add even now to triumphantly praise you with the praise that preceded me: 'In you is my memory forever' (Ps 70:14-16). And those saying, 'God has forsaken him,' were casting into his soul. For the greatest slander against the one forsaken is declared by [the phrase] 'God has forsaken him,' but 'I, however, through all things, hope,' he says, showing that he will not leave any place available. Toward 'God has forsaken him' and 'I, however, through all things, hope' [is the contrast]. And regarding the enemies unjustly killing, wanting to surround him as a destruction, remaining unharmed from them, he announces the life (the day called) the righteousness and salvation of the Lord. And since he did not know, he says, some writing of the law, for this reason not knowing, I will not enter upon the word and the shadow, according to the life-giving spirit and...

God has given the power to rule the mind of the written scriptures in a kingly way. Therefore I say, I will remember your righteousness alone, not being one who cares for the righteousness according to the shadow of the law, having become according to the righteousness in the law; Paul, blameless, writes that all those shadowy things, which previously were his gains, are to be counted as refuse because of the excellence of knowledge.

These things, as the great works of the Most High, and with them the wonders, have been lifted up, because a Savior man has come into being. For having been born of the virgin, a multitude of the heavenly host [cried out], 'Glory to God in the highest,' say, 'and peace on earth, in men goodwill' (Luke 2:14). For because of the goodwill having come into being in men, much peace prevailed, the enemies of all those on earth having been destroyed; but also glory has become in the highest, of the saved men having the ascent unto the highest. For how will not those having become perfect, just as the heavenly Father is perfect, having become in unsurpassable holiness, have God within themselves, all in all becoming? And the Lord himself says in the Gospels to his own Father, 'I will, Father, that where I am, they also may be with me, so that they may see my glory' (John 14:3).

Since God, through goodness, permitted to be tested by afflictions and evil things for the sake of some benefit, turning back again to himself, he gives life, imparting life to those who have seen through trials and evils, just as one is lifted up from the abysses, that is, from the depth of circumstances, the one being driven down. And since we have received the evil things, the painful and evil ones, as appropriate to the afflictions, following this, life-giving will be called according to the common life, and the ascent from the abyss; for since the evil things, having been stretched out, seem to kill and to bring down into Hades, if one receives the end of these things, he is being made alive by God and is brought up from the abysses of the earth.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
